dedupe_keys.name: regie intermunicipale de transport des collines transcollines gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: Régie intermunicipale de transport des Collines (Transcollines): GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Régie intermunicipale de transport des Collines (Transcollines). Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Bristol, Quebec, Canada, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Bristol, Quebec, Canada. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 2 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Bristol, Quebec, Canada). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Attributions, Bike Allowed, Continuous Stops, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence given by link only (https://github.com/transcollines/GTFS-RT/blob/master/LICENCE.MD); licence given by link only (https://github.com/transcollines/GTFS?tab=License-1-ov-file#readme). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
